info.title: Banking Compliance — authored HTTP catalog
info.description: Locally authored HTTP projection, not a vendor-published OpenAPI document. Typed request schemas come from the public MCP tools/list response. Public root discovery maps the three tools to /api/check, /api/lookup and /api/generate; a free campaign preview identifies POST /api/campaign. Campaign request JSON is deliberately unmodeled and the operation is excluded by provider configuration.

sources.purpose: Paid HTTP route names and advertised USDC prices.
check_content, lookup_rule and generate_compliant_post input schemas.
Free preview explicitly identifies POST /api/campaign and $5 price, without a complete request schema.

transformations: Translated MCP inputSchema into application/json request bodies without adding enums, bounds or defaults.
Rewrote descriptions for concise tool use; original structural constraints are preserved.
Added advisory price hints from public root discovery; live challenges remain authoritative.
Represented campaign discovery with a generic JSON object rather than inventing its request contract.

post.description: Check text against 56 US banking rules and return violations, warnings, suggestions and regulatory citations. Covers deposit/credit advertising, fair lending and disclosures. Cost: $0.005/call [public discovery].

text.description: Marketing, social, training, advertising or email text to check.

product_type.description: Product context: savings_account, money_market_account, certificate_of_deposit, checking_account, mortgage, home_equity, personal_loan, auto_loan, credit_card, business_loan, debit_card, mobile_banking, training_bsa_aml or training_reg_e.

include_warnings.description: Include warnings alongside violations; default true.

default.description: Provider JSON response; no authoritative response schema is published.

post.description: Search a 56-rule US banking database by topic, regulation or product. Returns matching rule IDs and requirements for further verification. Cost: $0.003/call [public discovery].

query.description: Keyword, regulation, rule ID or topic; for example APY or FED-REGDD-001.

category.description: Filter: required_disclosure, prohibited_language, required_language, claim_restriction, rate_advertising, formatting_requirement or fee_disclosure.

regulation.description: Regulation filter, such as Reg DD, Reg Z, UDAAP, ECOA, BSA, Reg E, FDIC, FFIEC, NMLS, TRID or CARD Act.

product_type.description: Product filter; for example savings_account, mortgage or credit_card.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return; provider documents default 10 and maximum 56.

default.description: Provider JSON response; no authoritative response schema is published.

post.description: Draft bank or credit union product posts with disclosure checks against 56 US banking rules. Returns post variations and check results; review before publishing. Cost: $0.10/call [public discovery].

product_type.description: Product: savings_account, money_market_account, certificate_of_deposit, checking_account, mortgage, home_equity, personal_loan, auto_loan or credit_card.

product_name.description: Product name; for example Premier Savings.

apr.description: Credit annual percentage rate; for example 6.99%.

minimum_balance.description: Balance required to earn the advertised rate; for example $10,000.

fdic_insured.description: Whether the institution is FDIC insured; provider defaults true.

is_credit_union.description: Whether to use NCUA rather than FDIC disclosures.

product_details.description: Product rates, terms, eligibility and disclosure details.

platform.description: Target: twitter, linkedin, facebook, instagram or general (default).

tone.description: Tone: professional (default), friendly, exciting or informative.

default.description: Provider JSON response; no authoritative response schema is published.

post.description: Generate seven banking social posts. The complete HTTP request contract is unpublished; this operation is excluded from the reusable provider. Cost: $5.00/call [public discovery].

schema.description: Unmodeled JSON request; public discovery does not establish the complete paid campaign body.

default.description: Provider JSON response; no authoritative response schema is published.
